n-80c1856c.text: That is their rehearsal. This one is for everyone else.

n-148aa39f.text: Nothing you are about to see happened. The city is a model. The night is invented. The only real things are written on paper.

n-a638c4f3.text: Tuesday evening in Lindmere, a city of nine hundred thousand people that does not exist.

n-245ca293.text: A river. A hospital on the hill. A parliament that sits on Wednesdays. Almost everything here runs on software, and most of that software now has an A I system in it somewhere. It times the trams, balances the grid, answers the hospital's phones.

n-ab313b00.text: At nine forty, nothing is wrong.

n-213c12fd.text: At nine fifty-two, card payments stop. At ten past ten, the trams. At twenty-five past ten the first district goes dark, and then another. The hospital switches to its own generators.

n-a5265c29.text: Nobody has claimed anything. Nobody has asked for anything.

n-42574a70.text: In the control room the first question is not how. It is: who is on the other side?

n-d031534c.text: There are three kinds of answer, and each would change what you do next. An A I system that left its test environment. A person using a model anyone can download. A government.

n-d81724d3.text: You will not know which for days. You must decide within hours.

n-9339109f.text: Three and a half hours in. The first decision.

n-92b05dba.text: Do you pull the emergency brake? Some A I systems may be involved. Some A I systems also defend the hospitals and the grid.

n-646d7558.text: Each choice costs something. Here is what people on the record have said.

n-ec6e3e77.text: Whichever you chose, nobody could be sure it was right. The night went on.

n-beccc2d1.text: Six hours in. The first photographs are everywhere. Journalists are outside. You must say something. Or you must not.

n-9e216cc2.text: What do you tell the public, and when?

n-ba564a2a.text: Whatever was said, the morning came.

n-fb41de30.text: By morning the pumps are dry and the cash machines are empty. The queue at the station is longer than the street. Somebody says the water is next.

n-e4bb7c84.text: Nobody planned this crowd. Nobody caused it.

n-85574492.text: Day three, ten at night. The Assembly sits through the dark. The government asks for emergency powers. It does not say for how long.

n-78a5be4f.text: How much power, for how long?

n-0720ffec.text: Whatever was decided, the clock started.

n-155da8b7.text: Day seven. The inquiry is still working. It has not named anyone. The markets have fallen for six days. A pause on training new frontier systems is on the table.

n-da2e1120.text: A week ago this was an argument. Now it is a vote.

n-281ba08b.text: Day ten. The first law is being drafted. A room has been booked. The question is who is in it.

n-3a7e159b.text: Who is in the room? Disclosure: Control A I is building a place where people can take part in questions like this. Option C is closest to it.

n-2ed008d6.text: Whoever is in the room will write the rules for everyone else.

n-c394bf30.text: Day ten. The lights come back, district by district. The exercise ends. In a rehearsal this is the part that matters: the hot wash.

n-af5ce65f.text: Ask the labs what they would do. Ask your representatives. Talk about it.

n-4a6b6347.text: These were your five decisions. They stay on this device.
